Blades 0.36.0 premade artwork, font and sound pack

The easiest installation is Blades-v0.36-USB.zip. Extract that combined ZIP
onto USB and launch Blades/default.xex; it already contains the complete
Assets folder. This separate pack remains available for manual updates:
extract it into Blades so Assets/blades.xzp is alongside default.xex.

This 235-entry payload includes derived tint masks and a cached logo shadow. Existing
blades, startup, animated background, Convection atlas, button prompts,
whooshes and disc-reading indicator remain. No conversion is needed.

Version 0.22 added File Manager below Homebrew, strict single-extension XEX
filtering, Y to remove saved scan paths, Unlimited first in the depth picker,
retained Scan Now results and no lower-left status/hint text. Audio CDs,
DVD videos and data discs are recognized with manual system-player handoffs;
physical-console verification is still required. The fresh walkthrough is
labelled desktop GPU playback with simulated storage, discs and launches.

Original project and indicator: zivvoz / DashX360, inspired by Microsoft's
Xbox 360 Dashboard. Artwork, font glyphs and audio retain ownership with
Microsoft and their respective rights holders. See the included notices.

Artwork/indicator source: https://github.com/ZivvoZ/dashx360

Version 0.36 corrects the system-player launch path when Flash: is not mounted.
The complete artwork payload and attribution notices remain unchanged.

Compatible with v0.36 native profile cards; account pictures are read in RAM on the console.

Includes original green default profile tile and circular GScore icon used in v0.36.

Achievement browser UI uses existing locked/secret/trophy/controller/scroll assets. Per-game pictures are read on the console and are not included here.

0.37 console-feedback colour refinement: Marketplace blends 0.35/0.36, Xbox Live softens the 0.35 hue, Media darkens slightly; Games and System retain 0.36. Existing motion and alpha/layout retained. 235 entries, including the unchanged derived retail5766 Xbox360 logo shadow. Preserve all ownership notices.
